title: Low-latency microroll playbook and leapback cheatsheet (June 2027) - draft
content:
Purpose:
This is a working microroll playbook focused on short, low-latency feature rollouts where the primary risk vector is tail latency and token cost regressions. Aim is to get 1–2 small changes safely into production with minimal blast radius and a fast "leapback" (immediate rollback equivalent) path if we detect regression.

Goals:
- Maintain p95 latency <= 220ms for gen endpoints; p99 guardrails for aggregator routes.
- Keep per-token cost delta < 6% vs baseline for the first 24h.
- No customer-facing errors > 0.1% of requests during ramp.

Scope and assumptions:
- Applies to hosted + dedicated; private deploys follow same cadence but use customer-specific flighting.
- Changes here are config/model-routing/quantization-only (no schema or DB migrations).
- We assume monitoring hooks (traces, token cost breakdown, token counts) are live for the route.

Quick reference (operator cheat):
- Start microroll: /ops/release start --env prod --lane micro --batch 10
- Abort mid-ramp: /ops/release abort --id <release-id> (immediate drop to 0% and restart default routing)
- Leapback (fast fallback to previous model variant): /ops/routing promote --model previous-variant --force
- Emergency throttle: set-rate-limit --route /v1/generate --qps 1

Pre-launch checklist (must green before 00:00):
- [ ] Canary fork deployed to staging with full trace sampling (trace-sample=100%).
- [ ] Telemetry dashboards: latency, error-rate, token_cost, KV-cache-hit, model-variant-distribution created and pinned.
- [ ] Canary prompts: run canonical eval set (10k tokens) and compare embedding/response diffs (regression < 1% threshold).
- [ ] Autoscaler config validated for short-burst scale-up (scale_window=30s, max_burst=3x).
- [ ] Alerting: p95/p99, error-rate, token-cost bump, and quality-regression alerts wired to #release-ops + oncall.
- [ ] Notify customer-success and platform SRE 1-hour prior.

Microroll cadence (recommended):
- T0 (start): 1% traffic for 15 minutes. Quick checks: errors, latency p95, token_cost.
- T1 (+15m): 5% for 15 minutes. Checks: same + KV-cache priming rate (should start rising).
- T2 (+30m): 10% for 30 minutes. Checks: modelling drift (if applicable), cost delta check.
- T3 (+60m): 25% for 45 minutes. Checks: downstream RTs, queueing, autoscale activity.
- T4 (+105m): 50% for 60 minutes. If all green, finalize to 100% after 1h stabilization window.
Note: if any guard trips, execute leapback (see below) and do postmortem.

Telemetry gates and thresholds (fast-fail rules):
- Error-rate: absolute > 0.1% OR increase > 3x baseline -> FAIL.
- Latency p95: > +45ms over baseline -> alert; > +90ms -> FAIL.
- Latency p99: increase > +200ms -> FAIL.
- Token-cost: rise > 6% sustained over 30m -> manual review; >10% -> FAIL.
- Model-quality: BLEU/ROUGE or embedding-sim below expected (see eval manifest) for > 10% of test prompts -> FAIL.
- KV-cache-hit: drop below 60% for routes that rely on prefix caching -> caution.

Leapback / rollback ladder (fastest to slowest):
1) Promote previous model-variant: /ops/routing promote --model prev --force -> immediate routing change, low effort.
2) Route-split reversion: move traffic back via weighted routing to previous variant (gradual if uncertain).
3) Global throttle + queueing: reduce overall QPS to preserve stability while ops triages.
4) Full abort: revert the release and re-deploy previous config.

Notes on model routing & quantization fallbacks:
- If new quantized build shows token-cost improvements but latency regressions, prefer a hybrid strategy: use quantized on non-latency-critical routes and leave high-priority routes on the previous variant.
- Make sure kernel-selection profiling snapshots are uploaded (infra artifact ID pattern: kernel-snap-YYYYMMDD-HHMM).
- Track memory pressure via nvml samples; spike in memory churn during ramp indicates bad KV cache interaction.

Operator runbook excerpt (for the oncall during ramp):
- 00:00-00:15: watch p95, errors. If p99 noise is high, increase trace-level to 100% for 5 minutes and capture stack traces.
- 00:15-00:45: verify autoscaler opened at least one new pool if CPU/GPU utilization > 70%. Check for OOMs on any worker.
- 00:45-01:30: check cost metrics for token-size regressions; if token size increased unexpectedly, check prompt changes and prefix caching.

Example rollout calendar (compact):
- 2027-06-09 21:00 PT: Dry-run on staging (smoke + eval set).
- 2027-06-10 02:00 PT: Microroll start in prod - small customer segment (internal sandbox).
- 2027-06-10 03:30 PT: Expand to broader slice per cadence if green.
- 2027-06-10 05:00 PT: Post-roll stabilization window begins.
- 2027-06-11 09:00 PT: Collect 24h metrics and draft release-note summary.

Draft release notes (for ops -> product handoff):
- Title: "Microroll: low-latency routing tweak + quantization pilot"
- Summary: "Rolled out config that shifts routing to kernel-optimized variant with optional 8-bit quantized fallback on non-critical routes. Initial rollout succeeded for 24h with p95 +20ms and token-cost -4%. Follow-up: continue monitoring embeddings for drift."
- Known issues: "Intermittent KV-cache misses observed on /v1/chat-stream when prefix length > 512 tokens. Working on priming strategy."
- Impact: "No customer-facing incidents; internal sandbox customers saw minor latency blips."

Open questions / TODOs:
- Add a small canary prompt set that focuses on long-context conversation sequencing (we don't have that in baseline).
- Should we automate leapback if p99 > +150ms for 5m? (Marcus to prototype auto-promote script).
- Validate eviction policy on deduplication caches during heavy burst (Ravi).

Notes to self (informal):
- If trace sampling trips S3 quota, temp reduce to 50% and capture critical spans.
- Remind product to add a short note to release email targeting high-bandwidth customers.
- Keep postmortem template ready: include kernel-snap id, PR number, and exact variant hash.

Appendix: quick checks to paste into Slack during ramp
- "p95: {{value}}ms, p99: {{value}}ms, errors: {{value}}%, token-cost delta: {{value}}%"
- "KV-hit: {{value}}%, autoscale events: {{count}}, model-variant: {{name}} (hash abc123)"

End of draft.
